findings.highlight: I feel like a lone traveler marching against the north wind.
findings.evidenceJa: こうなったときの彼女は、まさに北風に抗う旅人。生半可な強制じゃ、てこでも動かない。
findings.explanation: The line invokes 'The North Wind and the Sun': Setsuna is the traveler resisting the north wind, immovable by half-hearted force. Todokanai TL makes Haruki the traveler and turns the domestic persuasion problem into his own march against weather, breaking both agency and the fable setup.
findings.japanese:
こうなったときの彼女は、まさに北風に抗う旅人。
生半可な強制じゃ、てこでも動かない。
findings.todokanai: When she's like this, I feel like a lone traveler marching against the north wind. Ordinary means simply will not work.

findings.highlight: the only thing capable of stopping the north wind is the sun.
findings.evidenceJa: そう、太陽の光を浴びせるまでだ。
findings.explanation: Continuing the fable, Haruki decides to bathe the resistant traveler Setsuna in sunlight—use warmth and temptation where force fails. Todokanai TL says the sun stops the north wind, which is not what happens in the fable and compounds the preceding reassignment of traveler and wind.
findings.japanese: そう、太陽の光を浴びせるまでだ。
findings.todokanai: Of course, the only thing capable of stopping the north wind is the sun.

findings.highlight: you already do the laundry and clean the house whenever I look away.
findings.evidenceJa: 料理くらい守っておかないとカッコつかないよ～
findings.explanation: Setsuna concludes that if she does not at least defend cooking as her domain, she cannot preserve any pride as a wife. Todokanai TL drops the conclusion and leaves the quotation open, so Haruki's immediate ultimatum that she get up and cook lacks the stated stake he is answering.
findings.japanese:
「でも春希くん、洗濯も掃除も
隙あらばわたしから奪うじゃない。
料理くらい守っておかないとカッコつかないよ～」
findings.todokanai: "But Haruki-kun, you already do the laundry and clean the house whenever I look away.

findings.evidenceJa: 鬼、悪魔、裏の実行委員長～
findings.explanation: Setsuna caps 'ogre, demon' by calling Haruki the shadow or behind-the-scenes executive committee chairman, an in-character school-festival callback to his controlling organizer role. Todokanai TL converts 裏 into the underworld and 実行委員長 into CEO, deleting the callback and inventing a different fantasy title.
findings.japanese: 「うう、鬼、悪魔、裏の実行委員長～」
findings.todokanai: "Ohh, you're a demon! Satan himself! The CEO of the underworld!"

findings.highlight: This is the story of that winter we spent together, in this apartment.
findings.evidenceJa: そんな冬の、こんな部屋での、残り数日間の物語。
findings.explanation: The narration explicitly frames the story as the final few days of that winter in this apartment, immediately before the couple move. Todokanai TL expands it into the whole winter they spent together and removes the countdown that gives the domestic reminiscence its shape.
findings.japanese:
そんな冬の、こんな部屋での、
残り数日間の物語。
findings.todokanai: This is the story of that winter we spent together, in this apartment.

findings.highlight: it'll also be more efficient for our new neighbors.
findings.evidenceJa: 引っ越し蕎麦がそのまま年越し蕎麦に使えますから、隣近所としても効率的かなって
findings.explanation: Haruki jokes that the soba traditionally given to neighbors when moving can double as New Year's Eve soba, making the timing efficient for the neighborhood too. Todokanai TL omits the entire moving-soba/year-crossing-soba pun, retains only its conclusion, and leaves the quotation unclosed.
findings.japanese:
「それに、引っ越し蕎麦が
そのまま年越し蕎麦に使えますから、
隣近所としても効率的かなって」
findings.todokanai: "Besides, it'll also be more efficient for our new neighbors.

findings.highlight: but to the Ogiso household, they were akin to heresy.
findings.evidenceJa: 発言の後、雪菜含めた皆にめっちゃ怒られた。
findings.explanation: After Haruki reflexively declined their help, everyone—including Setsuna—became extremely angry with him. Todokanai TL substitutes the metaphor 'akin to heresy' and omits the concrete collective rebuke that demonstrates his continuing difficulty accepting family participation.
findings.japanese:
そんな、当然のように俺の口から出た辞退の言葉は、
小木曽家の人々にいたく反感を買ったらしく、
発言の後、雪菜含めた皆にめっちゃ怒られた。
findings.todokanai: Those words had left my mouth the day before as if it was the most natural thing in the world… but to the Ogiso household, they were akin to heresy.

findings.evidenceJa: 『貯金がある程度貯まるまではここでいいよ』って強硬に主張してたのは、どちらかと言えばお宅の娘さんだったんですけどね
findings.explanation: Haruki notes that it was primarily the mother's own daughter who adamantly insisted the apartment was fine until they had built up some savings. Todokanai TL cuts the embedded quotation after 'until,' omits the savings threshold and the attribution to Setsuna, and leaves the narration syntactically unfinished.
findings.japanese:
『貯金がある程度貯まるまではここでいいよ』
って強硬に主張してたのは、
どちらかと言えばお宅の娘さんだったんですけどね……
findings.todokanai: If I remember correctly, it was her daughter ーnot meーwho adamantly stated we should stay here until
